training_contract.fold_initialization: For each seed/fold, instantiate a fresh model, strict-load that seed's recovered Stage-A state, then construct fresh optimizers. Do not carry model or optimizer state between folds.

stage_b.optimizer_defaults: PyTorch defaults except supplied learning rates
stage_b.global_seed_placement: Python random, NumPy, torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all; cudnn deterministic=True and benchmark=False
stage_b.corruption: candidate drug heads only; reject every legal CLEAN indication head for the same disease
stage_b.negative_semantics: optimization contrasts only; not biological negatives or benchmark labels

scoring.orientation: candidate drug head -> clean_indication -> primary disease tail

serialization.stage_a: torch.save payload with state_dict, seed, complex_dim, corpus_manifest_sha256, plus base_epochs for seed 0
serialization.scores: np.savez_compressed with scores, disease_ids, drug_ids; canonical axes preserved
serialization.pilot_and_full_run_outputs: must be written outside frozen references with SHA-256 sidecars/provenance; historical checkpoints remain read-only

corpus.duplicate_and_direction_semantics: source order and duplicates preserved; no inverse relations or normalization

Reserve at least 4 GiB free VRAM; 8+ GiB is recommended, while A100-class hardware best matches provenance.

full_run_plan.required_compute: A CUDA-visible PyTorch environment with at least 4 GiB free VRAM (8+ GiB recommended), sufficient host RAM, and preferably A100-class hardware for closer environmental fidelity.
full_run_plan.execution_order: Run the seed-0/fold-0 pilot first. Review its fidelity report. Only after approval, execute remaining jobs independently; never carry fold state.
full_run_plan.output_layout: work/gate6b/runs/seed-{seed}/fold-{fold}/ for logs, resolved contract, RNG/environment snapshot, scores, metrics, and hashes; aggregate only disease-level utilities after all seed runs are complete.
full_run_plan.resume_policy: Atomic per-fold completion marker written only after scores, metrics, and hashes validate. On interruption, discard the incomplete fold directory and restart that fold from the immutable Stage-A checkpoint. Do not resume optimizer state unless an explicitly validated canonical same-fold checkpoint mechanism is introduced before execution.
full_run_plan.provenance: Record source/preregistration/checkpoint/corpus hashes, command, timestamps, hardware, software, deterministic flags, RNG seeds, update count, complete loss trajectory, runtime, peak memory, output hashes, and warnings per fold.
